Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1143196. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1143196'. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID.
